name: Ephraim Clark
milestones: First husband of Mary Frances Vantine; married her when she was 15
sources: Descendants of Jose Pierre Adams, compiled by William W. "Bill" Allen (2 April 2011 edition)
notes: First husband of Mary Frances Vantine (prior to John Wesley Adams). Father of Clay C. Clark. First name newly established in this source.
Bill Allen’s hypothesis: Apparently died soon after his son Clay was born, possibly in the Civil War. [Bill Allen, line 4154]
